maddeler.e:
تقترحي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِحِي (taqtariḥī) /taq.ta.ri.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# تُقْتَرَحِي (tuqtaraḥī) /tuq.ta.ra.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
